tools.name: get_rules
tools.description: Start here. Without a topic: the versions these docs describe, what to know before writing code with nuvui, the packages, the rules in a line each, and which component meets which need. With a topic: that rule in full, with wrong and right code.

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: Every component page, by package, with what each is for in a line. Pass a package to see only its pages.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: The pages that aren't about one component: getting started, theming, Tailwind, SCSS, forms, right to left, translation, the Content Security Policy, support, and recipes for whole screens.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: One page of the reference, as Markdown: a component's parts, props, examples, CSS variables, classes and accessibility, or a guide. Takes a page's id from list_components, list_guides or search_docs, or a component's name, such as Compare or DataTable. A section gives only that part of the page, suc

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Finds the sections of the reference that best answer a question or a few words, such as 'sortable table', 'dark mode' or 'error message on a field'. Each result names its page and section, for get_page.

tools.name: list_blocks
tools.description: Blocks are screens and parts of apps built from the components, such as a sign-in screen, a dashboard or a pricing table, each a TSX file and an SCSS file to copy and change. Look here before building a screen from nothing.

tools.name: get_block
tools.description: A block's files in full, the packages they need, and the command that adds it to a project.

tools.name: list_charts
tools.description: Charts built with @nuvui/charts on Recharts, each one file to copy: area, bar, line, pie, radar, radial, scatter and more.

tools.name: get_chart
tools.description: A chart's file in full, such as bar/stacked, from list_charts.

tools.name: get_tokens
tools.description: The design tokens as CSS custom properties, for your own CSS: var(--color-primary), never a color written out. A prefix gives only those, such as --color-, --radius- or --text-.

tools.name: get_changes
tools.description: What each @nuvui/* package added and changed after the versions a project has, from the packages' changelogs, newest first, and what's in the docs but in no release yet. Pass the @nuvui/* entries of the project's package.json. Without them: the latest version of each package.
